sanskrit: atha tasyāprameyasya tad vanaṃ paripṛcchataḥ viśvāmitro mahātejā vyākhyātum upacakrame
english: Then, as that one of immeasurable greatness inquired about the forest, Viśvāmitra of mighty splendour began to explain it.

sanskrit: eṣa pūrvāśramo rāma vāmanasya mahātmanaḥ siddhāśrama iti khyātaḥ siddho hy atra mahātapāḥ
english: "This, O Rāma, is the former hermitage of the great-souled Vāmana; it is known as Siddhāśrama, for here the great ascetic attained perfection."

sanskrit: etasminn eva kāle tu rājā vairocanir baliḥ nirjitya daivatagaṇān sendrāṃś ca samarudgaṇān kārayām āsa tad rājyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ
english: "At that very time, king Bali, son of Virocana, having conquered the hosts of gods together with Indra and the Marut-bands, exercised sovereignty over the three worlds, renowned throughout them."

sanskrit: bales tu yajamānasya devāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ samāgamya svayaṃ caiva viṣṇum ūcur ihāśrame
english: "While Bali was performing his sacrifice, the gods, with Agni at their head, assembled and themselves addressed Viṣṇu here at this hermitage."

sanskrit: balir vairocanir viṣṇo yajate yajñam uttamam asamāpte kratau tasmin svakāryam abhipadyatām
english: "'O Viṣṇu, Bali son of Virocana is performing a supreme sacrifice; before that rite is concluded, let your own purpose be accomplished.'"

sanskrit: ye cainam abhivartante yācitāra itas tataḥ yac ca yatra yathāvac ca sarvaṃ tebhyaḥ prayacchati
english: "'Whatever supplicants approach him from every quarter and ask for anything, wherever it may be, he grants all of it to them duly and in full.'"

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ surahitārthāya māyāyogam upāśritaḥ vāmanatvaṃ gato viṣṇo kuru kalyāṇam uttamam
english: "'Therefore, O Viṣṇu, for the benefit of the gods, resorting to your power of illusion, take on the form of a dwarf and accomplish the highest good.'"

sanskrit: ayaṃ siddhāśramo nāma prasādāt te bhaviṣyati siddhe karmaṇi deveśa uttiṣṭha bhagavann itaḥ
english: "'By your grace this place shall become known as Siddhāśrama; when the deed is accomplished, O lord of the gods, O Blessed One, arise from here.'"

sanskrit: atha viṣṇur mahātejā adityāṃ samajāyata vāmanaṃ rūpam āsthāya vairocanim upāgamat
english: "Then Viṣṇu of mighty splendour was born of Aditi, and assuming the form of a dwarf he approached the son of Virocana."

sanskrit: trīn kramān atha bhikṣitvā pratigṛhya ca mānataḥ ākramya lokāṃl lokātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ
english: "Having begged three paces of ground, and having received them with due respect, the soul of the worlds, devoted to the welfare of all beings, then strode across the worlds."

sanskrit: mahendrāya punaḥ prādān niyamya balim ojasā trailokyaṃ sa mahātejāś cakre śakravaśaṃ punaḥ
english: "He then gave the three worlds back to Mahendra, restraining Bali by his power; that one of mighty splendour brought the triple world once again under Śakra's sway."

sanskrit: tenaiṣa pūrvam ākrānta āśramaḥ śramanāśanaḥ mayāpi bhaktyā tasyaiṣa vāmanasyopabhujyate
english: "This hermitage, destroyer of toil, was formerly occupied by him; and I too, with devotion, have been dwelling here as a guest of that very Vāmana."

sanskrit: etam āśramam āyānti rākṣasā vighnakāriṇaḥ atra te puruṣavyāghra hantavyā duṣṭacāriṇaḥ
english: "It is to this hermitage that the obstacle-creating Rākṣasas come; here, O tiger among men, those evil-doers are to be slain by you."

sanskrit: adya gacchāmahe rāma siddhāśramam anuttamam tad āśramapadaṃ tāta tavāpy etad yathā mama
english: "Today, O Rāma, let us go to the peerless Siddhāśrama; that hermitage-ground, dear child, belongs to you just as it does to me."

sanskrit: taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve siddhāśramanivāsinaḥ utpatyotpatya sahasā viśvāmitram apūjayan
english: Seeing him arrive, all the sages dwelling in Siddhāśrama leapt up at once and in haste paid homage to Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: yathārhaṃ cakrire pūjāṃ viśvāmitrāya dhīmate tathaiva rājaputrābhyām akurvann atithikriyām
english: They rendered due honour to the wise Viśvāmitra, and likewise performed the proper rites of hospitality for the two princes.

sanskrit: muhūrtam atha viśrāntau rājaputrāv ariṃdamau prāñjalī muniśārdūlam ūcatū raghunandanau
english: Then, having rested for a moment, the two princes — tamers of foes, the delight of the Raghu line — stood with joined palms and spoke to the tiger among sages.

sanskrit: adyaiva dīkṣāṃ praviśa bhadraṃ te munipuṃgava siddhāśramo 'yaṃ siddhaḥ syāt satyam astu vacas tava
english: "Enter upon your consecration this very day — may it be well with you, O bull among sages; may this Siddhāśrama be brought to fulfilment, may your word prove true."

sanskrit: evam ukto mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ praviveśa tadā dīkṣāṃ niyato niyatendriyaḥ
english: Thus addressed, the mighty Viśvāmitra, great sage of brilliant splendour, then entered upon the rite of consecration, self-disciplined and with his senses fully restrained.

sanskrit: kumārāv api tāṃ rātrim uṣitvā susamāhitau prabhātakāle cotthāya viśvāmitram avandatām
english: The two princes also passed that night with minds well-composed; and rising at the hour of dawn, they paid reverence to Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: atha tau deśakālajñau rājaputrāv ariṃdamau deśe kāle ca vākyajñāv abrūtāṃ kauśikaṃ vacaḥ
english: Then those two princes — tamers of foes, knowing the right place and the right time, skilled in fitting speech — spoke these words to Kauśika at the proper place and time.

sanskrit: bhagavañ śrotum icchāvo yasmin kāle niśācarau saṃrakṣaṇīyau tau brahman nātivarteta tatkṣaṇam
english: "O Blessed One, O Brahman, we wish to know at what time those two night-roaming Rākṣasas are to be guarded against, so that we may not let that moment pass."

sanskrit: evaṃ bruvāṇau kākutsthau tvaramāṇau yuyutsayā sarve te munayaḥ prītāḥ praśaśaṃsur nṛpātmajau
english: As the two scions of Kākutstha spoke thus, eager for battle, all those sages were pleased and praised the royal princes.

sanskrit: adya prabhṛti ṣaḍrātraṃ rakṣataṃ rāghavau yuvām dīkṣāṃ gato hy eṣa munir maunitvaṃ ca gamiṣyati
english: "Guard the hermitage, O Rāghavas both of you, for six nights from this day forward; this sage has entered upon the consecration and will observe a vow of silence."

sanskrit: tau tu tad vacanaṃ śrutvā rājaputrau yaśasvinau anidrau ṣaḍahorātraṃ tapovanam arakṣatām
english: Hearing those words, the two renowned princes, sleepless, stood guard over the ascetic grove for the full six days and nights.

sanskrit: upāsāṃ cakratur vīrau yattau paramadhanvinau rarakṣatur munivaraṃ viśvāmitram ariṃdamau
english: The two heroes, ever watchful, supreme archers, maintained their vigil; tamers of foes, they guarded the foremost of sages, Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: atha kāle gate tasmin ṣaṣṭhe 'hani samāgate saumitrim abravīd rāmo yatto bhava samāhitaḥ
english: When that period had passed and the sixth day arrived, Rāma spoke to Saumitri: "Be vigilant, be fully composed."

sanskrit: rāmasyaivaṃ bruvāṇasya tvaritasya yuyutsayā prajajvāla tato vediḥ sopādhyāyapurohitā
english: While Rāma thus spoke, eager for combat, the sacrificial altar then blazed forth, together with the officiating priests and the ācāryas.

sanskrit: mantravac ca yathānyāyaṃ yajño 'sau saṃpravartate ākāśe ca mahāñ śabdaḥ prādur āsīd bhayānakaḥ
english: The sacrifice proceeded duly with the proper recitation of mantras; and in the sky a great and dreadful sound arose.

sanskrit: āvārya gaganaṃ megho yathā prāvṛṣi nirgataḥ tathā māyāṃ vikurvāṇau rākṣasāv abhyadhāvatām
english: Like a storm-cloud that bursts forth in the rainy season covering the sky, those two Rākṣasas, conjuring their illusions, rushed forward.

sanskrit: mārīcaś ca subāhuś ca tayor anucarās tathā āgamya bhīmasaṃkāśā rudhiraughān avāsṛjan
english: Mārīca and Subāhu, and their retinue as well, arrived with terrifying aspect and showered down floods of blood.

sanskrit: tāv āpatantau sahasā dṛṣṭvā rājīvalocanaḥ lakṣmaṇaṃ tv abhisaṃprekṣya rāmo vacanam abravīt
english: Seeing those two rushing forward suddenly, the lotus-eyed Rāma glanced toward Lakṣmaṇa and spoke these words.

sanskrit: paśya lakṣmaṇa durvṛttān rākṣasān piśitāśanān mānavāstrasamādhūtān anilena yathāghanān
english: "See, Lakṣmaṇa, these ill-natured flesh-eating Rākṣasas — I shall scatter them with the Mānava weapon like clouds dispersed by the wind."

sanskrit: mānavaṃ paramodāram astraṃ paramabhāsvaram cikṣepa paramakruddho mārīcor asi rāghavaḥ
english: Rāghava, exceedingly wrathful, hurled at Mārīca the Mānava weapon — most noble and supremely brilliant.

sanskrit: sa tena paramāstreṇa mānavena samāhitaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ yojanaśataṃ kṣiptaḥ sāgarasaṃplave
english: Struck by that supreme Mānava weapon, Mārīca was hurled a full hundred yojanas away and cast into the ocean's surge.

sanskrit: vicetanaṃ vighūrṇantaṃ śīteṣubalapīḍitam nirastaṃ dṛśya mārīcaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇam abravīt
english: Seeing Mārīca rendered senseless and spinning, tormented by the force of the numbing arrow, driven far away, Rāma spoke to Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: paśya lakṣmaṇa śīteṣuṃ mānavaṃ dharmasaṃhitam mohayitvā nayaty enaṃ na ca prāṇair viyujyate
english: "See, Lakṣmaṇa, how the Mānava numbing arrow, charged with righteousness, only stuns him and carries him away — it does not separate him from his life."

sanskrit: imān api vadhiṣyāmi nirghṛṇān duṣṭacāriṇaḥ rākṣasān pāpakarmasthān yajñaghnān rudhirāśanān
english: "These others, however — the merciless evil-doers, those Rākṣasas steeped in wickedness, destroyers of sacrifices, feeders on blood — these I shall slay."

sanskrit: vigṛhya sumahac cāstram āgneyaṃ raghunandanaḥ subāhur asi cikṣepa sa viddhaḥ prāpatad bhuvi
english: The delight of the Raghu line took up the mighty Āgneya weapon and hurled it at Subāhu; struck, Subāhu fell to the ground.

sanskrit: śeṣān vāyavyam ādāya nijaghāna mahāyaśāḥ rāghavaḥ paramodāro munīnāṃ mudam āvahan
english: Taking up the Vāyavya weapon, the illustrious and most noble Rāghava slew the rest, bringing joy to the sages.

sanskrit: sa hatvā rākṣasān sarvān yajñaghnān raghunandanaḥ ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitas tatra yathendro vijaye purā
english: Having slain all those Rākṣasas who had disrupted the sacrifice, the delight of the Raghu line was honoured by the seers there, just as Indra was honoured of old after his victories.

sanskrit: atha yajñe samāpte tu viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ nirītikā diśo dṛṣṭvā kākutstham idam abravīt
english: Then, when the sacrifice was complete, the great sage Viśvāmitra, beholding the quarters free of all affliction, spoke these words to the scion of Kākutstha.

sanskrit: kṛtārtho 'smi mahābāho kṛtaṃ guruvacas tvayā siddhāśramam idaṃ satyaṃ kṛtaṃ rāma mahāyaśaḥ
english: "I am fulfilled, O mighty-armed one; the command of your teacher has been carried out by you. Siddhāśrama is now truly made perfect, O Rāma of great renown."

sanskrit: atha tāṃ rajanīṃ tatra kṛtārthau rāmalakṣaṇau ūṣatur muditau vīrau prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
english: Then Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, having accomplished their purpose, passed that night there — the two heroes joyful, with hearts filled with delight.

sanskrit: prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ kṛtapaurvāhṇikakriyau viśvāmitram ṛṣīṃś cānyān sahitāv abhijagmatuḥ
english: At the dawning of the night into morning, having performed their morning rites, the two together approached Viśvāmitra and the other sages.

sanskrit: abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṃ jvalantam iva pāvakam ūcatur madhurodāraṃ vākyaṃ madhurabhāṣiṇau
english: Having saluted the foremost of sages — blazing like fire — the two who were sweet of speech spoke words that were sweet and noble.

sanskrit: imau svo muniśārdūla kiṃkarau samupasthitau ājñāpaya yatheṣṭaṃ vai śāsanaṃ karavāva kim
english: "We two, O tiger among sages, stand before you as your servants; command us as you will — what order shall we carry out?"

sanskrit: evam ukte tatas tābhyāṃ sarva eva maharṣayaḥ viśvāmitraṃ puraskṛtya rāmaṃ vacanam abruvan
english: When they had spoken thus, all the great sages, placing Viśvāmitra at their head, spoke these words to Rāma.

sanskrit: maithilasya naraśreṣṭha janakasya bhaviṣyati yajñaḥ paramadharmiṣṭhas tatra yāsyāmahe vayam
english: "O foremost of men, Janaka of Mithilā will perform a sacrifice most righteous; we are going there."

sanskrit: tvaṃ caiva naraśārdūla sahāsmābhir gamiṣyasi adbhutaṃ ca dhanūratnaṃ tatra tvaṃ draṣṭum arhasi
english: "You too, O tiger among men, shall go with us; and there you should see a wondrous jewel of a bow."

sanskrit: tad dhi pūrvaṃ naraśreṣṭha dattaṃ sadasi daivataiḥ aprameyabalaṃ ghoraṃ makhe paramabhāsvaram
english: "That bow, O best of men, was formerly given in assembly by the gods — of immeasurable strength, fearsome, supremely brilliant in sacrifice."

sanskrit: nāsya devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ kartum āropaṇaṃ śaktā na kathaṃ cana mānuṣāḥ
english: "Neither gods, nor Gandharvas, nor Asuras, nor Rākṣasas, nor men of any kind are able to string it."

sanskrit: dhanuṣas tasya vīryaṃ hi jijñāsanto mahīkṣitaḥ na śekur āropayituṃ rājaputrā mahābalāḥ
english: "Mighty kings and princes who wished to test the prowess of that bow were unable to string it."

sanskrit: tad dhanur naraśārdūla maithilasya mahātmanaḥ tatra drakṣyasi kākutstha yajñaṃ cādbhutadarśanam
english: "That bow, O tiger among men, belonging to the great-souled lord of Mithilā, you shall see there, O scion of Kākutstha, along with the sacrifice wondrous to behold."

sanskrit: tad dhi yajñaphalaṃ tena maithilenottamaṃ dhanuḥ yācitaṃ naraśārdūla sunābhaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ
english: "That bow with its fine nock, O tiger among men, was solicited as the fruit of the sacrifice from the lord of Mithilā by all the gods."

sanskrit: evam uktvā munivaraḥ prasthānam akarot tadā sarṣisaṃghaḥ sakākutstha āmantrya vanadevatāḥ
english: Having spoken thus, the foremost of sages then set out for the journey, together with the assembly of seers and the scion of Kākutstha, having taken leave of the forest deities.

sanskrit: svasti vo 'stu gamiṣyāmi siddhaḥ siddhāśramād aham uttare jāhnavītīre himavantaṃ śiloccayam
english: "Fare you well; I depart, my purpose fulfilled, from Siddhāśrama; I go to the Himālaya, the mountain mass of rock, on the northern bank of the Jāhnavī."

sanskrit: pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā siddhāśramam anuttamam uttarāṃ diśam uddiśya prasthātum upacakrame
english: Having then circumambulated the peerless Siddhāśrama in the auspicious clockwise direction, he began to set out toward the northern quarter.

sanskrit: taṃ vrajantaṃ munivaram anvagād anusāriṇām śakaṭī śatamātraṃ tu prayāṇe brahmavādinām
english: As that foremost of sages proceeded, some hundred carts belonging to the company of Brahman-reciters followed him in the procession.

sanskrit: mṛgapakṣigaṇāś caiva siddhāśramanivāsinaḥ anujagmur mahātmānaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim
english: The herds of deer and flocks of birds dwelling in Siddhāśrama also followed the great-souled Viśvāmitra, the great sage.

sanskrit: te gatvā dūram adhvānaṃ lambamāne divākare vāsaṃ cakrur munigaṇāḥ śoṇākūle samāhitāḥ
english: Travelling a great distance of road, when the sun was sinking low, the companies of sages made camp, composed and at peace, on the bank of the Śoṇā.

sanskrit: te 'staṃ gate dinakare snātvā hutahutāśanāḥ viśvāmitraṃ puraskṛtya niṣedur amitaujasaḥ
english: When the day-maker had set, those ones of boundless energy bathed, offered oblations into the fire, and then sat down with Viśvāmitra at their head.

sanskrit: rāmo 'pi sahasaumitrir munīṃs tān abhipūjya ca agrato niṣasādātha viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ
english: Rāma too, together with Saumitri, having honoured those sages, then sat down in front of the wise Viśvāmitra.

sanskrit: atha rāmo mahātejā viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim papraccha muniśārdūlaṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ
english: Then Rāma of mighty splendour, filled with curiosity, questioned Viśvāmitra, the great sage, that tiger among sages.

sanskrit: bhagavan ko nv ayaṃ deśaḥ samṛddhavanaśobhitaḥ śrotum icchāmi bhadraṃ te vaktum arhasi tattvataḥ
english: "O Blessed One, what region is this, adorned with flourishing forests? I wish to hear about it — may all be well with you; please describe it truly and in full."

sanskrit: codito rāmavākyena kathayām āsa suvrataḥ tasya deśasya nikhilam ṛṣimadhye mahātapāḥ
english: Prompted by Rāma's words, the one of excellent vows and great austerity, in the midst of the sages, narrated the complete account of that region.
